name: [[692,348,96]] alternating-sum obstructed telescoping reversing-fold prime-CPM stabilizer code, P=173, w=32

provenance.construction: Alternating-sum obstructed telescoping reversing-fold prime-CPM stabilizer code over Z_173 (M=4 blocks, R=2 block-rows, n=4*173=692). Row 0 has A0[m]=x^(c[m]) f[m], D0[m]=f[(m+1) mod 4]; Row 1 has A1[m]=g[(m+1) mod 4], D1[m]=x^(-c[m]) g[m] with c=[1, 0, 0, 0] (alternating sum 1 != 0 mod 173, obstructing low-weight single-qubit-per-block Y-logicals). Check (j,s) places X at m*173+(s-a) mod 173 for a in A_j[m] and Z at m*173+(-s+d) mod 173 for d in D_j[m]. f=[[0, 54, 92, 127], [54, 74, 100, 136], [10, 58, 69, 130], [38, 53, 129, 168]]; g=[[10, 32, 88, 92], [1, 21, 39, 107], [23, 92, 117, 154], [33, 48, 114, 126]].
provenance.notes: Discovered via alternating-sum obstructed telescoping reversing-fold symplectic algebra over prime Z_173. Tightened via 100,000 uniform symplectic Stern/RIS trials (w=96), 20,000 block-structured symplectic Stern/RIS trials (w=98), 50,000-trial orbit-fold verification (no refutation), and random Pauli-frame RIS (lightest=123); backed by explicit weight-96 Pauli witness.
